holiday.simpleMeaning: time when you do not work or study
holiday.sentence: Why can a school summer holiday feel endless, but a year at work can feel very short?

memory.simpleMeaning: something you remember from the past
memory.sentence: Today, we will explore time, attention, memory, and routine in a simple way.

routine.simpleMeaning: the usual things you do again and again

proportion.simpleMeaning: the size of one part compared with the whole
proportion.contextMeaning: how big one year is in a whole life
proportion.sentence: This is called the proportion effect.

experience.contextMeaning: what a person has lived through
experience.sentence: It is that our life experience changes.

novelty.sentence: Now let’s look at attention and novelty.

familiar.contextMeaning: already normal and easy to recognize
familiar.sentence: Novelty means something new, not familiar.

automatic.contextMeaning: happening by habit instead of careful thought
